## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number) or Addresses #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update (improving guides, specs, or inline comments)
- [ ] Performance improvement (reducing latency or memory usage)
- [ ] Refactoring (restructuring code without functional changes)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the repository's [Coding Standards](docs/coding-standards.md).
- [ ] I have executed the 17-step backend integration test suite (`python test_suite.py`) and verified all tests pass.
- [ ] I have executed the multimodal test suite (`python test_multimodal_logic.py`).
- [ ] I have verified the frontend static build compiles cleanly (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have added appropriate documentation in `docs/` for any new capabilities.
- [ ] I have updated the `CHANGELOG.md` if applicable.

## Screenshots / Evidence (if applicable)
Add screenshots or terminal logs verifying the change.
